column1: # One verdict per published Gmail API method. Held by `go run ./scripts/gates api-coverage`.
# Columns: method id, state, phase, verdict. The verb and path live in testdata/api-surface.json.
# used: a client call exists (internal/gapi). planned: judged used or gated, built in the named phase (§16).
# out: deferred or written off; the verdict says why.
